 Miss Universe Vietnam 2026 winner stripped of crown six weeks after win
 By Dat Nguyen    November 18, 2026 | 06:21 am PT 
 Get VnExpress first in Google Search 
 See more of the news you trust. Make VnExpress a preferred source to prioritise our updates in your Google search results
 Pageant organizers have revoked Nguyen Quynh Anh’s Miss Universe Vietnam 2026 title about six weeks after she was crowned, saying she breached the terms of their agreement. 
 The decision took effect Wednesday, said Pham Duy Khanh, general director of Five6 Entertainment Jsc, the company behind the pageant.
 A representative for the organizers said Anh had repeatedly broken company rules. The company had previously barred her from performing onstage for six months after allegations that she had made disparaging remarks about colleagues. She later attended a community event without notifying Five6 Entertainment, the representative said.
 Nguyen Quynh Anh reacts as she was crowned Miss Universe Vietnam in October 2026. Photo courtesy of Five6 Entertainment Jsc
 A few days ago, Anh told the organizers and the company that she needed time to rest and seek treatment for mental health concerns and could not yet sign the management contract as originally agreed.
 "However, she continued to accept invitations to perform and attend events without first reaching an agreement with the company," Khanh said.
 Anh’s representatives have yet to comment on the decision.
 The Miss Universe Vietnam 2026 final took place in Hai Phong on Oct. 2. Ten days later, an exchange purportedly from a private group chat that included Anh began circulating across several online platforms.
 The messages included disparaging remarks and gossip about several people connected to the pageant.
 On Oct. 13, Anh acknowledged her mistake and apologized to those involved and to the public. She said the episode was a lesson that would help her mature.
 My Anh, Emma Maria Fernandez Le, Hong Dang and Dieu Huyen placed first through fourth runner-up, respectively. The organizers have yet to announce who will replace Anh.
 Anh was originally chosen to represent Vietnam at Miss Universe in Puerto Rico in November.
 On Oct. 21, however, the organizers issued a statement confirming she would not compete because of a dispute between the entity that holds the rights to send Vietnam’s contestant and the Miss Universe Organization.
 The 75th edition of the pageant began more than a week ago, with about 116 contestants from around the world. This marks the first time in 12 years that Vietnam has missed Miss Universe. Its last absence was in 2014.
 Born and raised in Hanoi, Anh came to public attention as the runner-up on "The Face Vietnam" in 2018. She studied human resource management at Trade Union University in Hanoi and Saigon Tourism College.
 In December 2021, Quynh Anh won the Asian Supermodel competition. She has also acted in several film productions, most recently the series "Loi Hua Dau Tien" (The First Promise).
